title: nextTrackerClock
responsibility: Read and issue the durable hybrid logical clock used to order Tracker operations.

inputs.name: trackerClockMilliseconds.value
inputs.description: Stored Tracker hybrid logical clock to parse.

inputs.name: nextTrackerClock.node
inputs.description: Local node name appended as the final clock segment.

inputs.name: nextTrackerClock.floor
inputs.description: Last durable clock, or null when there is no previous operation.

outputs.name: trackerClockMilliseconds
outputs.description: Epoch milliseconds from the clock, or zero for a malformed value.

outputs.name: nextTrackerClock
outputs.description: Fixed-width clock that sorts after the last durable clock for this node.
